craft_notes: Sthāyin: equal-pairs (enemy-friend, honor-dishonor flattened; fullness known). Rows: row 3 (known→may be). Close: may be (optative refrain with v123 — happiness permitted twice). Rejected: 'equanimity' — killed: same-in kept (pairs named, not the virtue); 'the Absolute' — killed: brahma's fullness kept (fullness-word, not philosophy).

lines: Same in enemy and friend, honor, dishonor:
brahma's fullness known — happy may be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samo mānāvamānayoḥ || brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet

reads_against.argmap: How should enemy and friend stand? → Brahma's fullness known, all pairs equal — happiness follows.
c1_essence: Enemy same as friend, honor same as dishonor: happy.
